name: bohemix-rounded-glyph
preamble: A cohesive library of compact, rounded, solid geometric glyphs for the BohemiX desktop application. Medieval game-management metaphors are reduced to one bold silhouette with calm modern geometry. Cool white and neutral grey forms stay legible over both pale-blue and deep-blue application surfaces. Near-black is never the dominant fill.

construction.grid: 24x24 keyline; 20x20 maximum live area; optical centering
construction.corner_radius: rounded terminals and 1-2 unit internal radii
construction.fill_rule: single solid silhouette with intentional negative-space cutouts
construction.color_rule: one foreground color per glyph; semantic accent is applied by the consuming UI
construction.detail_budget: one metaphor, usually 1-3 joined masses, no micro-detail
construction.shared_parts: consistent circles, chevrons, plus/minus signs, document corners, and person heads
construction.motif: soft corner cuts and compact central negative space
construction.weight_hierarchy: the silhouette remains visually dominant; no internal accent outweighs it
